Here is the commit message I'd use.

```
fix(auth): make password-reset links expire after 24h, not 1h

The reset-token expiry was computed in the wrong time unit. The config
specifies a 24-hour window, but the value was stored as if it were
already in the unit the token store expects, so the effective lifetime
came out roughly 24x too short and links died after about an hour.

Convert the configured 24-hour window to the correct unit in
src/auth/reset.ts before storing it on the token. No change to the
configured value itself.

Users who requested a reset and opened the link more than an hour later
were told it had expired and had to request a new one.
```

The subject names the user-visible behavior rather than the mechanism, since that is what someone scanning history is looking for. The body explains the cause, the exact scope of the change, and who was affected, so a reader can judge whether a related report is the same bug without opening the diff.
